scenario.name: Turn indicator during a turn or lane change
scenario.description: The vehicle changes lane to pass a stopped vehicle, or turns at a junction, with other road users relying on its indicator

events.description: Indicates the wrong direction before a turn or lane change

goals.statement: Avoid signalling a manoeuvre other than the one performed

scenario.pass: The indicator always matches the commanded and achieved steering direction; on a mismatch hazard lights come on

parameters.label: ODD-20 Ego speed: 46 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

legend.plan: Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
legend.envelope: Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
legend.meant: Meant to do: its indicator matches the turn
legend.meant_mark: Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle
legend.hazard: Where the hazard lies: HE-09.1 Indicates the wrong direction before a turn or lane change
legend.key: Amber, ringed: the road user the scenario is about

ego.motion_label: Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033); choreography, not Autoware's planned braking
